items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: So we played there for him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was living up in there. Cause that other, that, several people lived in there.

Yeah. The other one of them boys had a wife there too, you know what I mean? In that place, you know what I mean? So we played there for him. So then we played up to the school, you know, playing for the concert. Remember that concert we played?
